title: Holding More Than One Vacation Package at the Same Time
content:
A traveller may hold more than one packaged holiday at a time, and each package carries its own product, its own payment schedule and its own cancellation ladder. No ceiling is recorded on how many of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products one traveller may hold at once.

1. **Each package stands on its own product.** The product a package was quoted under governs that package alone. A traveller holding a Value Bundle Package and an Ocean Cruise Package at the same time is holding two packages on two sets of terms.
2. **Duplicate review before the deposit.** Two packages departing on the same date for the same party are referred for duplicate review before the deposit is taken, because suppliers hold one allocation against one party. The match that refers them is a match of departure date for the same party; two packages of the same party departing on different dates are not referred.
3. **Nothing is aggregated between packages.** A deposit paid on one is never moved to another, and a free group place earned on one never reduces the price of another.
4. **One traveller, counted once, charged in full on each.** A traveller named on two packages is still one traveller, and each package charges its own per-traveller amounts in full.

## Points of judgement

Where a party holds a package departing on the eleventh of a month and asks for a second package departing on the twelfth, the departure dates do not match and the second package is not referred for duplicate review. Where the second package departs on the eleventh as well, it is referred, and the referral stands before the deposit on it is taken rather than after.

Where a party holds two packages and the first has taken its deposit, that deposit belongs to the first package: it is not moved across to meet the deposit on the second, which takes its own deposit under its own product.
